title: Agricultural Meteorology
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the quantity or percentage of water vapor (water in gas form) in the air."
Relative humidity is the quantity or percentage of water vapor (water in gas form) in the air.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the single most important factor in ensuring accurate readings."
Siting is the single most important factor in ensuring accurate readings.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to take readings of the various weather elements, so the data collected can be analyzed using weather station software."
Weather stations sensors are used to take readings of the various weather elements, so the data collected can be analyzed using weather station software.
fib: ______ is the study of periodic plant and animal life cycle events and how these are influenced by seasonal and annual variations in climate, as well as habitat factors (such as elevation).
Phenology is the study of periodic plant and animal life cycle events and how these are influenced by seasonal and annual variations in climate, as well as habitat factors (such as elevation).
______ is a common instrument used in most weather stations An assembly of a vane plate (which can have many shapes) and a needle is mounted on a vertical axis, which allows it to revolve freely.

The Wind Vane (Direction) is a common instrument used in most weather stations An assembly of a vane plate (which can have many shapes) and a needle is mounted on a vertical axis, which allows it to revolve freely.
